title: Fresh prepared-solve per reanchor replay of DSW-09
method: Replay the exact tangent/reanchor sequence, but instantiate a fresh MODFLOW6 prepared solve for every tangent. Carry only the newly solved head into the next reanchor.
gates: head within 1e-10 m of closed-form root
each fresh affine solve reports MODFLOW converged
comparison: If this closes while the same one-iteration reanchor sequence inside one prepared solve stalls, the failure is history/state retention within the prepared solve rather than coupling algebra or API coefficient resolution.
forbidden: do not claim which internal MODFLOW/IMS state causes the history effect until separately traced
